themes.evidence: designing multi-step LLM workflows and task-specific agents
implement and orchestrate multi-step agentic workflows
advanced prompt engineering strategies, evaluation frameworks, and RAG pipelines
using evaluation tools such as Langfuse or LangSmith
design and maintain scalable, production-grade backend systems for AI applications
conduct rapid experimentation and research on LLM capabilities and translate findings into production

archetype_rationale: Day-to-day the role creates, orchestrates, and evaluates LLM-based agents and chained/multi-step agentic workflows, with prompt engineering, RAG, and eval tooling at the center. Backend/FastAPI/cloud work exists but serves the agent systems rather than defining the job.
notes: Strong backend + IaC/cloud expectations (FastAPI, Django, AWS/GCP/Azure, Terraform) mean platform/ML-engineering is a close second archetype; regulated biopharma/clinical-R&D domain raises the bar on evaluation rigor and clear communication with non-technical medical writers.
